WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
first_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as baseline FROM telescope_averages
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN first_baseline fb
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > fb.baseline
),
second_baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as baseline FROM above_first
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT af.avg_pulse
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_baseline sb
  WHERE af.avg_pulse > sb.baseline
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse,
  AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT baseline FROM first_baseline)) as mean_excess_first,
  AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT baseline FROM second_baseline)) as mean_excess_second
FROM final_telescopes
